method: Deterministic Matplotlib plot of the saved constructed experiment
scope: Same kinematics with nominal/truth inertia mismatch; independent validation trajectory, analytic motion derivatives, IID 0.02 N*m torque noise. No measured robot accuracy or physical-parameter uniqueness claim.
visual_review: Relative singular values from training-column-scaled matrix; cutoff 1e-10.
Values at/below 1e-18 are clipped only for display and marked by down triangles.
Two per-joint validation RMSE groups use identical held-out samples.
Numeric labels, hatch and marker shapes distinguish series without relying on color.
All labels, axes, footer and title inspected at full source size.
reference_note: Mean residual convention corrected to measured minus predicted; all plotted singular values and RMSE values unchanged, reproduced PNG byte-identical.
numerical_revision_20261030: Aggregate RMSE rejects broadcasting and uses scaled residuals. Column L2 norms use stable hypot accumulation, preserving finite extreme column scales. Reproduced references and figure; sub-threshold singular values change at floating-point noise level, while retained rank, labeled per-joint errors and scientific conclusions stay the same.
